rows.en: So you made it!! You lousy Lost Heroes!!
That voice... It's Belial, isn't it!?
That voice... It's Belial, isn't it!?
I got it! That voice, it's Belial, ain't it!?
I've heard that voice before... That's right... You're Belial!!
That voice... if I remember right... ...Belial!!
But it ain't just monsters sleeping here... Kaijin, MS, every bastard you lot ever took down is here.
Get it? Their suffering, their hatred, their grudges have become an insane amount of Minus Energy,
and it's overflowing in this Cube!!
Shut up, you bastard!! I said show yourself!!
No need for that! You lot are gonna end up as food for the Belial Army right there!!
Fuhahaha!! Did you see that!! At last, the Belial Army is born!!
With the "Plasma Spark" I took from you lot, I've gained the ultimate power!!
...You're saying you brought the monsters back!?
Belial... It seems he's revived the monsters.
Huh? You revived the monsters? Damn, that's something... Wait, no time to be impressed!!
Are you saying you revived the monsters!!
Just so you know, they weren't simply revived. They came back powered up to the absolute limit!!
Now, who should I send first!?
Ohh... These guys go first. Looks like they've got power to burn, huh?
Now! You lot, entertain me with a show where they all get wiped out, got it!?
Avenge yourselves on the hated Lost Heroes!! Whoever wins glory gets made an executive!!
Heh... Well, it's no fun if you croak this easily. But how long can you last!!
But right now, all we can do is press on.
Still, right now we just have to keep going, don't we.
But no matter what, all we can do is press on.
But no matter what, all we can do is press on.
But no matter what, all we can do is press on.
But right now, we ain't got a choice but to keep movin'.
But right now we've just gotta keep going no matter what. Right?
But right now, all we can do is press on.

notes.note: #0.2-16: 15-row leader block (starts in story_144). Order from 0702.bla Pt_Chara_Check run 11-15,1-10: Ultraman, Seven, Taro, Mebius, Zero, Rider 1, Black RX, Momotaros, W, OOO, Nu, Zeta, God, Wing Zero, 00. #0.15-16 = Wing Zero, 00.
Labelled ???; it is Belial's voice (#0.18 names him, #0.33 Belial confirms). 'domo' contempt -> 'lousy'.
#0.18-32: same 15-leader order. #0.25 Momotaros (rough), #0.26 W/Shotaro, #0.27 OOO, #0.30 God. Identical Japanese kept identical; #0.18-22 vs #0.28-32 differ only in punctuation/pause.
Source row ends with a break; #0.35 continues Belial's speech.
'MS' kept as in source (mobile suits). 'yarou' -> 'bastard'.
#0.36-37 one sentence split across two rows; cut at the matching point.
Source kanji here looks like a typo/mis-decode for 'overflowing' (afureru); read as 'overflowing'. Inferred.
#0.38-52: 15-leader block, same order; #0.45 is Momotaros (slot 8), rough 'Shut up, you bastard'.
Belial Army: glossary term (source here uses gundan, same army).
Belial's Giga Battlenizer summon, '100-tai Monsload'. 'Monsload' is the franchise's English for the summon call; not in glossary. Elongation kept.
Plasma Spark in quotes as in source.

#0.61-75: 15-leader block in a different order (0702.bla second Pt_Chara_Check run 15,14,13,12,11,5,4,3,2,1,10,9,8,7,6): Zero, Mebius, Taro, Seven, Ultraman, OOO, W, Momotaros, Black RX, Rider 1, 00, Wing Zero, God, Zeta, Nu. Confirmed by #0.68 rough Momotaros line in slot 8. Lines aimed at Belial ('you').
W slot, but phrasing ('you da ne') is Philip's observational tone; he comments to the team about Belial, so 'he'.
RX slot repeats 'Belial!! Show yourself!!' instead of reacting to the revival; translated as written.
Momotaros echoes Belial; subject restored as 'you'.
God Gundam slot ('to iu no ka') -> 'Are you saying...'. Source ends with '!!', kept.
Belial choosing which revived monster to send; 'I' restored.
Belial picks Bemstar, Vakishim and Alien Metron (#0.82-84).

Roars: this Bemstar cry is a plain 'kiiii' (differs from the modified Bemstar roar in story_047), so a new rendering. Vakishim 'Fuhaaaah!!' and Alien Metron 'Gwaaaaaagh!!' are new; reused for #0.87-89.
Belial to the monsters; 'zenmetsu show' = the heroes getting wiped out. Inferred whose annihilation from #0.86.
After the battle (GoToBattle precedes it in the script); Belial taunts the heroes ('you').

#0.94-108: 15-leader block (continues in story_146), order 13,14,12,15,11,3,4,2,5,1,8,9,7,10,6: Taro, Mebius, Seven, Zero, Ultraman, Momotaros, W, Black RX, OOO, Rider 1, God, Wing Zero, Zeta, 00, Nu. Matches voices (#0.95 polite Mebius, #0.99 Momotaros, #0.100 Shotaro, #0.102 OOO addresses Ankh). Replies to Ankh's #0.93; Ankh answers in #0.109. Subject 'we' restored.
Source row ends with a stray break; ignored.

report: 80/80 rows. Leader orders taken from 0702.bla Pt_Chara_Check runs (three different orders), confirmed by rough Momotaros slots. Uncertain: #0.37 typo kanji read as 'overflowing'; #0.67 W variant read as Philip's tone with 'he'; #0.85 whose annihilation inferred. New roars for Bemstar (plain kiii), Vakishim, Alien Metron. Not in glossary: 'Monsload' (Belial's Giga Battlenizer summon, #0.54).
